name: MIMO-NeRF-self-R2
definition: A variant of MIMO-NeRF using two reformulated MIMO MLPs with reduction factors R1=1 and R2=1.
summary: MIMO-NeRF-self-R2 is a NeRF configuration using two reformulated MIMO MLPs with reduction factors of one, which reduces training time by parallelizing point evaluation while balancing parallelism against reduction factors.
